text.aura: Your presence is morning mist over a lake: soft, dreamy and quietly enchanting. Gye carries a gentle, intuitive presence that makes people feel calmer and a little more curious. You read as artistic, sensitive and mysterious, the person who seems to notice things no one else does. Your glow is subtle and atmospheric. It doesn't hit people all at once, it settles over them slowly, until they realize they can't stop thinking about you. There's a quiet magic in your energy, like a rainy day in a good bookshop. The glow-up for you isn't becoming louder or more visible overnight. It's adding enough clarity to the mist that people can see you clearly, and remember the shape of you, not just the feeling.
text.how-people-read-you: Before you say a word: soft, shy, intriguing. People assume you're creative and emotionally deep, and they're right. Some feel protective of you, others feel a little mystified. The misreading is that people often underestimate your strength. They think you're fragile when you're actually incredibly resilient, rain wears down mountains over time. Some also think you're distant or uninterested, when you're simply observing before engaging. To be read more accurately, share your perspective sooner, even if your voice is quiet. Make eye contact a beat longer. Let your humor out, because you're often funnier than people expect. Your mystery is appealing, but your clarity is what helps people truly connect with you.
text.colors: Start with your home palette, soft Water: misty blue, slate, smoky gray, deep navy, ink and soft black. These look dreamy and atmospheric on you, like a watercolor painting of the sea. Metal feeds Water, so silver, pearl and soft white add luminosity, especially near your face. Lavender and soft lilac bring out your gentle, romantic side. For clarity and a bit of life, add Wood tones like sage or eucalyptus green. Be careful with very strong, bright colors like neon or tomato red in large amounts. They can overwhelm your subtle aura and make you look uncomfortable. Your colors should feel like rain on a window: soft, cool and quietly beautiful.
text.style: What suits you is dreamy minimalist with an artistic touch. Flowing fabrics, soft layers, oversized knits, long skirts, a beautiful coat for rainy days. You look great in outfits with gentle movement and subtle texture. Vintage and handmade pieces, a ring from a market, a hand-knitted scarf, suit your soul. The trap is blurring into the background, so many soft, muted pieces that your style disappears. Add one clear focal point: a silver statement earring, a deep blue coat, a sharp shoe. Hair soft and natural, makeup dewy and fresh. Your best photo is in soft, diffused light, a rainy window, a foggy street, a dim café, looking slightly away with a quiet, knowing expression.
text.vibe: Your next-level vibe is the mist that clears into a rainbow. Think of the quiet, mysterious webtoon character whose backstory turns out to be the heart of the whole series. The shift for you is self-expression. Share your art, your writing, your playlists, your strange beautiful thoughts with more people. Speak up in a conversation where you'd usually stay quiet. Wear the one bold piece that makes you feel brave. Let people see your humor and your opinions, not just your gentleness. Keep your sensitivity, it's a true gift. Just pair it with a little confidence, and your soft aura becomes unforgettable rather than easy to miss.
text.aura-dims: The glow goes out when you've absorbed too many other people's emotions. You become foggy, withdrawn and a little lost. You might stay inside, scroll endlessly, avoid messages and dress in whatever's softest and darkest. Your glow fades into gray. The reset is gentle clearing. Spend time alone in a calm, quiet space. Listen to music that matches your mood, then music that lifts it. Write down everything you're feeling, without editing. Take a walk in the rain or near water. Wear something light, silver or pearl to brighten your energy. Then reach out to one safe person. Mist always lifts eventually. You just need a little quiet, and a little light, to let it go.

panels.speaker: bom
panels.text: Gye, your aura is morning mist. Dreamy, gentle, people feel calmer around you.

panels.speaker: yeon
panels.text: They also forget you're in the room. You disappear on purpose, don't you?

panels.speaker: bom
panels.text: Misty blue, pearl, a long rainy-day coat. You look like a watercolor.

panels.speaker: yeon
panels.text: So many soft grays you've become a cloud. Add one sharp thing.

panels.speaker: bom
panels.text: Your glow-up is clarity. Let people see the shape of you.

panels.speaker: yeon
panels.text: Speak up once in the group chat. Not a sticker. Actual words.

spring.intro: Spring Wood grows on Water, so a spring Gye aura is gentle rain on new leaves: soft, kind and quietly essential. Others see you as approachable, intuitive and calming, the person strangers tell their life story to on trains. Your style instinct is pastel and delicate, but it can fade into the background when you put everyone else first. Your glow-up is definition. Metal, your resource, brings silver, white and a crisp collar, giving your softness edges. Keep sea blue and misty gray as your base, then add one fresh green detail. The spring Gye glow is a raindrop on a leaf catching the light: tiny, clear and impossible to look away from.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Spring Gye, pastel on pastel and you vanish. A crisp white collar gives you an outline.

summer.intro: Summer's Fire is the element Water controls, and a light rain spends itself fast doing it, so a summer Gye aura is a summer shower: refreshing, brief and loved by everyone who feels it. Most people see you as cool, easy and a relief from the noise. But a summer shower evaporates quickly, and your style can disappear behind louder friends in louder prints. Your glow-up is substance. Metal, your resource, brings silver, pearl and clean white, and deep blue anchors your own element. Wear one cool, distinctive piece, an ice-blue silk shirt or a silver cuff. The summer Gye glow is a glass of iced water in July: simple and exactly what everyone wanted.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Summer Gye, an ice-blue silk shirt. You're the coolest thing at the barbecue.

autumn.intro: Autumn's Metal feeds Water from beneath, so an autumn Gye aura is dew on cool stone: clear, precise and gently luminous. Others see you as perceptive, intelligent and a little mysterious. You probably dress thoughtfully in quiet neutrals, and you may have changed three times before leaving the house. With so much support, you can drift into overthinking every outfit. Your glow-up is expression. Wood, your output, brings sage, teal and leafy prints, and a touch of warm color adds life. Choose one detail that speaks before you do, a sage scarf or a teal bag. The autumn Gye glow is morning mist over a pond: soft, layered and quietly unforgettable.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Autumn Gye, three outfit changes before 9am. Grab the sage scarf and trust your first instinct.

winter.intro: Winter is Water's own season, so a Gye born then is snow and mist: hushed, mysterious and deeper than it looks. Your aura reads as enigmatic and elegant, but people can find you hard to approach, like a beautiful closed door. You likely live in black, gray and navy from November to March. Your glow-up is warmth. Fire, your wealth element, brings rose, coral and warm gold, while Earth gives camel and cream as a grounding base. A soft rose knit under a charcoal coat is your winter signature. Gold earrings finish it. The winter Gye glow is a lantern in snowfall: quiet, glowing and impossible to forget.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Winter Gye, a rose knit under charcoal. A lantern in snowfall. People find their way.

earth.intro: A Gye Water born in the Earth days has an aura of is rain on warm ground: gentle, perceptive and easy to miss in a crowd. People feel calm around you. Earth controls Water, so a closet full of muddy tones can make you disappear. Your glow-up is clarity. Metal feeds Water, so pearl, silver and soft white bring you forward, and misty blue or lavender keeps your softness. A little shine near the face, an earring or a glossy fabric, catches light the way rain does.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Gye, you're not the mud, you're the rain. Wear the pearl.

strength.strong: A strong Gye Water aura is a mist that fills the whole valley. With plenty of Water and Metal, you seem intuitive, mysterious and quietly powerful, and your style often leans dark, layered and elusive, like you are always about to leave. The blind spot is overwhelming through enigma: people find you fascinating but cannot read you at all. Add warmth and clarity: a rose or coral detail, a clean structured piece, a warmer neutral like camel. Let people see one clear signal of who you are. Mystery is lovely. Being approachable as well is what turns intrigue into friendship.
strength.weak: A weak Gye Water aura is a raindrop on a hot pavement, gone before anyone notices it was there. With little Water or Metal support, you may fade into the background, dressing to avoid attention and adapting to other people's tastes without a fuss. The blind spot is shrinking until nobody knows what you like. Your glow-up is presence: a silver piece that catches the light, a deep blue you love, a fabric with a gentle sheen. Choose one item that makes you feel luminous and wear it often. Let people see the shimmer.

balance_text.too_much_wood: Too much Wood gives your aura lots of drive and upward energy, but it can read as restless or intense, always busy, always growing. Your style may lean practical and outdoorsy, sometimes at the expense of polish. Balance it with Metal touches: a crisp white shirt, silver jewelry, cleaner lines, one tailored piece. Declutter your wardrobe so what remains feels intentional. Your glow is strongest when your ambition looks calm, like a tall tree that doesn't need to prove it's growing.
balance_text.missing_wood: Missing Wood means your aura can lack a sense of freshness and new beginnings. You might stick to the same outfits for years or feel unsure about trying new styles. Bring in Wood: greens, botanical prints, natural fabrics like linen and cotton, plants in your space. Try one new style element each month, a different silhouette, a new accessory, a new hair clip. Growth looks good on you. Let your style evolve a little, the way spring changes a garden.
balance_text.too_much_fire: Too much Fire makes your aura bright, bold and sometimes overwhelming. Whether you wear it loudly or quietly, your look can carry more heat than the moment needs: one statement too many, or an intensity people feel before you've said a word. Balance it with Water: navy, deep blue, black accents, calmer silhouettes. Choose one statement per outfit instead of five. Let some quiet into your presence too, listening more, moving slower. Your glow is already strong. Cooling it slightly makes it look richer and more confident.
balance_text.missing_fire: Missing Fire means your aura can feel understated, sometimes so understated that people overlook you. You might default to neutrals and avoid anything that draws attention. Bring in Fire: a red lip, a coral scarf, warm gold jewelry, a little shimmer. Seek out sunlight in photos and in life. Let yourself be seen in small ways: post the photo, wear the bright thing, laugh openly. Visibility is a skill, and it looks lovely on you when you allow it.
balance_text.too_much_earth: Too much Earth gives you a grounded, warm aura that can slide into heavy or overly practical. Your wardrobe may be comfortable but samey, lots of beige, brown and safe basics. Balance it with Wood: fresh greens, lighter fabrics, a playful print, something that moves when you walk. Try one unexpected piece. Rearrange your space for a fresh feeling. Your stability is beautiful. A little lightness on top keeps it from looking stuck.
balance_text.missing_earth: Missing Earth can make your aura feel scattered or ungrounded, lots of ideas, many style moods, not much consistency. Your outfits may change wildly depending on your mood. Bring in Earth: camel, beige, warm brown, ochre, and solid basics like a good coat and reliable shoes. Build a small capsule wardrobe you can trust. Ceramics, wood and warm lighting at home help too. When your foundation is steady, your creativity looks intentional instead of chaotic.
balance_text.too_much_metal: Too much Metal gives your aura sharpness and polish that can tip into cold or severe. Your style may be immaculate but a little untouchable: very clean lines, lots of black, white and gray, everything controlled. Balance it with Fire: warm colors near your face, soft textures, a smile that comes sooner. Let one thing be imperfect on purpose, rolled sleeves, tousled hair, a playful accessory. Precision is your strength. Warmth makes it inviting.
balance_text.missing_metal: Missing Metal can make your aura feel soft but a little undefined. People like you, but they might not remember your style clearly. Bring in Metal: silver jewelry, crisp white, sharp tailoring, clean shoes, a structured bag. Edit your wardrobe so every piece earns its place. A clear signature, the same ring, the same scent, a consistent color, gives your look definition. Clarity doesn't make you colder. It makes you memorable.
balance_text.too_much_water: Too much Water gives your aura depth and mystery, but it can read as distant, moody or hard to reach. You might hide in dark colors and oversized layers. Balance it with Earth: warm neutrals near your face, structured pieces, a grounded silhouette. Add a little Fire too, a coral or rose accent, to bring warmth. Let people see your expression clearly. Your mystery is magnetic. A bit of warmth makes it feel welcoming, not unreachable.
balance_text.missing_water: Missing Water means your aura can feel busy and bright without much depth or calm. You might always be on, always moving, with little stillness. Bring in Water: navy, midnight blue, black, flowing fabrics, a more relaxed silhouette. Create quiet moments in your day and let them show in your style, softer textures, fewer accessories. Water by your bed and slow evenings help your energy settle. Depth looks good on you. Give it some room.

too_much_wood.text: Too much Wood: hiking boots, three plants and a tote bag. Add one sharp silver thing.

too_much_fire.text: Too much Fire: red bag, gold chain, leopard coat. Pick one. The others can wait.

too_much_fire.speaker: bom
too_much_fire.text: Your warmth is your magic. Let navy or stone frame it.

too_much_earth.speaker: yeon
too_much_earth.text: Too much Earth: beige, oatmeal, sand, more beige. You look like a very calm cupboard.

too_much_earth.speaker: bom
too_much_earth.text: Your steadiness is beautiful. One silver piece or a deep blue lifts it.

too_much_metal.speaker: yeon
too_much_metal.text: Too much Metal: you look expensive and impossible to talk to. Add one soft texture.

too_much_metal.speaker: bom
too_much_metal.text: Your polish is stunning. A warm knit lets people come closer.

too_much_water.speaker: yeon
too_much_water.text: Too much Water: all black, all mystery, all the time. Even vampires wear burgundy.

too_much_water.speaker: bom
too_much_water.text: Your depth is magnetic. A warm color helps people find the door.

missing_wood.speaker: bom
missing_wood.text: Missing Wood? Try a sage scarf or a leafy print. Let your style grow a little.

missing_wood.speaker: yeon
missing_wood.text: Same outfit since 2021 isn't a signature. It's a rut with good lighting.

missing_fire.speaker: bom
missing_fire.text: Missing Fire? A coral scarf or warm gold earrings changes how people greet you.

missing_fire.speaker: yeon
missing_fire.text: Head-to-toe gray says 'don't notice me'. Is that really the message?

missing_earth.speaker: bom
missing_earth.text: Missing Earth? A camel coat or a terracotta bag grounds your whole look.

missing_earth.speaker: yeon
missing_earth.text: Five trends this month, zero signature. Commit to something longer than a week.

missing_metal.speaker: bom
missing_metal.text: Missing Metal? A crisp white shirt or a silver cuff gives your look clean edges.

missing_metal.speaker: yeon
missing_metal.text: Everything slightly creased and slightly oversized reads accidental. Tailor one piece.

missing_water.speaker: bom
missing_water.text: Missing Water? Deep navy or a fluid silk adds calm depth to your look.

missing_water.speaker: yeon
missing_water.text: Always bright, always on. Let one outfit be quiet. People lean in.
